info.name: Zipline AI Fetcher fetch workflow API
Poll workflow state after a run has been created

params.name: workflowId
params.description: Workflow ID returned by the workflow start API or shown in the Zipline Hub UI.

items.docs: Returns the workflow-level status and the node execution timeline for a workflow run. Requires viewer access when role-based authorization is enabled. When authentication is enabled, include a bearer token (obtainable via `zipline auth get-access-token`).
